name: Purple Kush
summary: **Purple Kush** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] stabilized by growers in Oakland, California, in the mid-1990s. A cross of [[hindu-kush|Hindu Kush]] and [[purple-afghani|Purple Afghani]], both indica landraces. It circulated only as a clone for years before [[breeder:DNA Genetics]] released it in seed form.
